	(function(){
	/* Everything is delegated from document: this used to bind per-nav at
	   parse time, which found nothing when the script printed in the head
	   before the header template had rendered. */
	var MEGA = '.hd-catmenu--mega';
	var DRILL = '.hd-catmenu--drill';
	var openId = null, hideTimer = null;

	function panels(nav){ return nav.querySelectorAll('[data-hd-mega-panel]'); }
	function megaShow(nav, id){
		panels(nav).forEach(function(pl){ pl.hidden = pl.getAttribute('data-hd-mega-panel') !== String(id); });
		nav.querySelectorAll('[data-hd-mega]').forEach(function(t){
			t.setAttribute('aria-expanded', t.getAttribute('data-hd-mega') === String(id) ? 'true' : 'false');
		});
		openId = id;
	}
	function megaHide(nav){
		panels(nav).forEach(function(pl){ pl.hidden = true; });
		nav.querySelectorAll('[data-hd-mega]').forEach(function(t){ t.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false'); });
		openId = null;
	}

	document.addEventListener('mouseover', function(e){
		var nav = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest(MEGA) : null;
		if(!nav){
			document.querySelectorAll(MEGA).forEach(function(n){
				clearTimeout(hideTimer); hideTimer = setTimeout(function(){ megaHide(n); }, 200);
			});
			return;
		}
		clearTimeout(hideTimer);
		var trig = e.target.closest('[data-hd-mega]');
		if(trig){ megaShow(nav, trig.getAttribute('data-hd-mega')); return; }
		if(!e.target.closest('[data-hd-mega-panel]')){
			hideTimer = setTimeout(function(){ megaHide(nav); }, 200);
		}
	}, true);

	document.addEventListener('focusin', function(e){
		var trig = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('[data-hd-mega]') : null;
		if(!trig) return;
		var nav = trig.closest(MEGA); if(nav) megaShow(nav, trig.getAttribute('data-hd-mega'));
	});

	/* touch and keyboard: first activation opens the panel, second follows the link */
	document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
		var trig = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('[data-hd-mega]') : null;
		if(trig){
			var nav = trig.closest(MEGA); if(!nav) return;
			var id = trig.getAttribute('data-hd-mega');
			if(!nav.querySelector('[data-hd-mega-panel="'+id+'"]')) return;
			if(openId !== id){ e.preventDefault(); megaShow(nav, id); }
			return;
		}
		if(!e.target.closest(MEGA)){
			document.querySelectorAll(MEGA).forEach(megaHide);
		}
	});
	document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
		if(e.key === 'Escape') document.querySelectorAll(MEGA).forEach(megaHide);
	});

	/* ---- drill ---- */
	function stackSync(stack){
		var trail = stack.hdTrail || [stack.querySelector('[data-hd-root]')];
		stack.hdTrail = trail;
		stack.querySelectorAll('.hd-catmenu__pane').forEach(function(pn){
			pn.classList.remove('is-here','is-left');
		});
		trail.forEach(function(pn,i){ pn.classList.add(i === trail.length-1 ? 'is-here' : 'is-left'); });
		var cur = trail[trail.length-1];
		if(cur) stack.style.minHeight = cur.scrollHeight + 'px';
	}
	document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
		if(!e.target.closest) return;
		var stack = e.target.closest(DRILL + ' .hd-catmenu__stack');
		if(!stack) return;
		if(!stack.hdTrail) stack.hdTrail = [stack.querySelector('[data-hd-root]')];
		var open = e.target.closest('[data-hd-open]');
		if(open){
			var pane = stack.querySelector('[data-hd-pane="'+open.getAttribute('data-hd-open')+'"]');
			if(pane){ stack.hdTrail.push(pane); stackSync(stack); }
			return;
		}
		if(e.target.closest('[data-hd-back]') && stack.hdTrail.length > 1){
			stack.hdTrail.pop(); stackSync(stack);
		}
	});
	function initDrills(){ document.querySelectorAll(DRILL + ' .hd-catmenu__stack').forEach(stackSync); }
	if(document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initDrills);
	else initDrills();
	window.addEventListener('resize', initDrills);
	/* Elementor popups render their contents late */
	if(window.jQuery) jQuery(document).on('elementor/popup/show', initDrills);
	})();
